mechanism: trimAssetCache(cache) is only called when url.pathname.startsWith('/assets/'), so other static files matched by STATIC_ASSET_PATTERN (e.g. /pdf.worker.min.mjs, /icons/*.png) are never evicted from the cache.
recommendation: Call trimAssetCache(cache) for all STATIC_ASSET_PATTERN entries or track non-precache static entries under a bounded LRU.

mechanism: trimAssetCache deletes assetKeys.slice(0, excess) assuming cache.keys() is LRU-ordered, and cache hits at line 135 do not refresh entry recency.
recommendation: Maintain explicit access timestamps or re-put on hit if LRU eviction is desired, or document FIFO eviction.

mechanism: Navigation handler only falls back to cached /index.html when fetch() rejects (network error), not when the server returns HTTP 404 for a deep SPA route.
recommendation: If response.status === 404 on a navigate request, serve cached /index.html when available.

mechanism: Stale-while-revalidate asset fetch has no timeout when cached is undefined, so a hanging network request stalls asset loading indefinitely on captive portals.
recommendation: Wrap fetch(request) with an AbortController timeout when no cached response exists.

mechanism: EMAIL regex /\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\b/g matches malformed domains with consecutive dots (user@example..com) or leading/trailing hyphens.
recommendation: Tighten domain label pattern to (?:[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?\.)+[A-Za-z]{2,}.

mechanism: ADDRESS regex only matches US-style street suffixes with optional 2-letter state + 5-digit ZIP, missing UK/EU postcodes and international street formats.
recommendation: Add international postcode/address patterns or document US-only address scope.

mechanism: Overlap resolution in redactSensitiveData uses O(N^2) rawSpans.some(...) instead of the O(N log N) sweep used in mergeSemanticRedactions.
recommendation: Sort candidates by start ascending (longest first on tie) and filter overlaps in a single O(N log N) pass.

mechanism: mergeSemanticRedactions pushes match start/end offsets relative to base.redactedText into base.matches whose existing entries use offsets relative to base.originalText.
recommendation: Document the coordinate space or separate semanticMatches / recompute offsets consistently.

mechanism: restoreFromVault replaces all /\[[A-Z0-9_]+_\d+\]/g tokens unconditionally; if the original document literally contained e.g. [EMAIL_1], it gets overwritten by the vault entry.
recommendation: Track or escape pre-existing bracketed tokens before redaction, or only restore tokens known to be inserted.

mechanism: extractPdfTextLocally appends a space or newline after every PDF text item, which splits words across kerning/ligature boundaries or hyphenated line breaks.
recommendation: Check item transform/x-gap or de-hyphenate line-endings before joining PDF text items.

mechanism: For extensionless image files (e.g. pasted Blob with type image/jpeg), meta.extension falls back to 'png' (ext || 'png') instead of deriving from resolvedMime.
recommendation: Derive fallback extension from resolvedMime (e.g. resolvedMime.split('/')[1]).

mechanism: extractPdfTextLocally never calls pdf.destroy() or loadingTask.destroy() after extracting text, leaking PDF.js worker memory across uploads.
recommendation: Call await pdf.destroy() in a finally block after page extraction.

mechanism: readFileAsText does not strip a leading UTF-8 BOM (\uFEFF), which can interfere with first-line heading or regex matching.
recommendation: Strip leading \uFEFF with raw.replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').

mechanism: replaceInDocxParagraphs collapses all <w:r> runs in a matched <w:p> into a single <w:r> with firstRPr, stripping mixed inline formatting (bold, italic, hyperlinks, bookmarks).
recommendation: Map replacement offsets across existing <w:r> runs or preserve non-text run elements.

mechanism: Fallback <w:t> replacement in exportDocx only runs on word/document.xml, skipping header*.xml and footer*.xml.
recommendation: Apply the fallback <w:t> replacement loop across all targetPaths.

mechanism: if (!item.original || !item.replacement) continue skips intentional clause deletions where replacement is empty string.
recommendation: Check item.replacement === undefined || item.replacement === null instead of falsy !item.replacement.

mechanism: exportPdf replaces all non-ASCII characters ([^\x20-\x7E]) with spaces, silently dropping CJK, Cyrillic, Arabic, and non-NFD-decomposable Latin characters (e.g. ø, ł, ß).
recommendation: Embed a Unicode-capable TrueType font or transliterate common Latin ligatures before stripping.

mechanism: computeWordDiff allocates new Uint32Array((m + 1) * width) up to 2,000,000 cells (~8 MB) synchronously on the main thread.
recommendation: Use Myers O(ND) diff or row-rolling Hirschberg/space-optimized DP to cut memory from O(MN) to O(N).

mechanism: 3rd-tier anchor match in replaceExcerptInText only checks the first match of startPattern; if those 5 words appear earlier (e.g. TOC) and endPattern is >1200 chars away, it fails instead of trying later occurrences.
recommendation: Iterate through subsequent startPattern matches with a global regex until a <=1200-char span to endPattern is found.

mechanism: openHistoryDb() caches cachedDbPromise, but saveScanRecord/listScanRecords/deleteScanRecord/clearScanHistory all call db.close() in finally, which triggers db.onclose (clearing cache) and can close the DB mid-transaction for concurrent callers.
recommendation: Keep the cached IDBDatabase open across operations instead of calling db.close() in every finally block.

mechanism: saveScanRecord calls sanitizeScanRecord(record) without customTerms, so custom terms are not re-scrubbed if present in title or summary.
recommendation: Accept optional customTerms in saveScanRecord and forward to sanitizeScanRecord.

mechanism: stripCodeFences picks the last fenced code block and falls back to indexOf('{')..lastIndexOf('}'), which breaks if trailing prose contains a code snippet or braces.
recommendation: Use a balanced-brace JSON scanner (like extractFirstJsonObject) and prefer the first valid JSON code fence.

mechanism: extractSentenceExcerpt slices .slice(0, 260) from the start of the sentence; if the matched keyword is >260 chars into a long sentence, the excerpt omits the matched keyword itself.
recommendation: Center the 260-char window around match index when the sentence exceeds 260 characters.

mechanism: analyzeDocumentHeuristically calls clampScore(undefined, clauses) without passing crossClauseFindings.length, so heuristic cross-clause findings never contribute to overallRiskScore.
recommendation: Pass crossClauseFindings.length as the 3rd argument to clampScore.

mechanism: initializeFirebaseServices() has no in-flight promise deduplication; concurrent calls (e.g. React StrictMode double-mount) can race and call initializeAppCheck twice on the same FirebaseApp.
recommendation: Cache and return an in-flight initialization promise until it settles.

mechanism: buildHybridParams for semantic_pii sets mode: InferenceMode.ONLY_ON_DEVICE while still populating inCloudParams (dead config).
recommendation: Omit inCloudParams for semantic_pii just like document_analysis does for only_on_device.

mechanism: In runHybridDocumentAnalysis, runChunk mutates combinedPromptText/combinedOutputText in Promise.all completion order (non-deterministic) and performs a dead write to resolvedSource.
recommendation: Collect per-chunk prompt/output strings by index and join deterministically after Promise.all; remove dead resolvedSource write.

mechanism: computeHybridDelta is called without redactionLatencyMs, so Stage 0 deterministic redaction latency is always reported as 0 in delta.totalLatencyMs.
recommendation: Measure Stage 0 redactSensitiveData duration and pass it as redactionLatencyMs to computeHybridDelta.

mechanism: createClauseNegotiator calls ensureChat() outside the try/catch block; if modelFactory throws, sendMessage rejects with an orphaned user message in history instead of falling back.
recommendation: Move ensureChat() inside the try/catch block so modelFactory errors fall back cleanly to buildOfflineNegotiationFallback.

mechanism: throwIfAborted(turnOptions?.signal) after the try/catch block throws AbortError without popping the pending user message from history.
recommendation: Pop the pending user message from history if throwIfAborted throws after the try/catch.

mechanism: handleScanActiveTab sets isScanningTab=true and awaits runAuditOnText(), keeping the button label stuck on 'Extracting Active Tab...' during the entire AI audit.
recommendation: Set setIsScanningTab(false) immediately after tab text extraction completes, before awaiting runAuditOnText().

mechanism: catch block checks /^file:\/\//i.test(pageUrl) using stale React state because executeScript threw before setPageUrl(payload.url) ran.
recommendation: Check activeTab.url instead of stale pageUrl state.

mechanism: SidePanelApp renders executiveSummary, rationale, and redlineProposal without restoreFromVault(), exposing raw [EMAIL_1]/[ORG_1] tokens to the user.
recommendation: Add a local vault-restore toggle or restore tokens on-device for display/copy in SidePanelApp.

mechanism: copyText sets a 1600ms setTimeout without cleanup on unmount or rapid consecutive copies.
recommendation: Store timer ID in a ref, clear previous timer before setting a new one, and clear on unmount.

mechanism: Escape key handler and backdrop click (line 189) call onClose() without calling abortRef.current?.abort(), unlike the Close button.
recommendation: Abort in-flight negotiation requests in Escape and backdrop click handlers.

mechanism: CATEGORY_ORDER, TOKEN_SPLIT_RE, and TOKEN_EXACT_RE omit PEM_KEY and IPV6, so those masked categories are never shown as chips or highlighted in the redacted preview.
recommendation: Add PEM_KEY and IPV6 to CATEGORY_ORDER, TOKEN_SPLIT_RE, and TOKEN_EXACT_RE.

mechanism: Modal dialog (role='dialog' aria-modal='true') lacks an Escape key handler to close.
recommendation: Add a keydown listener for Escape when isOpen is true.

mechanism: useEffect only syncs draftRedline when clause.id changes, so external updates to decision.customRedline (e.g. from ClauseNegotiationDrawer) leave draftRedline stale if Edit is clicked.
recommendation: Include effectiveRedline in the useEffect dependency array when !isEditing.

mechanism: handlePrintPdf calls itself recursively (handlePrintPdf()), causing a stack overflow if invoked.
recommendation: Remove the dead recursive handlePrintPdf function or replace its body with window.print().

mechanism: Clipboard error message contains literal JSX-like string '{exportDownloaded ? "Downloaded .md" : "Download .md"}' inside single quotes.
recommendation: Replace with plain text: 'Use Download .md instead.'

mechanism: Document highlight matcher searches report.redaction.originalText using clause.excerpt generated from redactedText, so excerpts containing [EMAIL_1] or [ORG_1] fail to match and highlight.
recommendation: Restore vault tokens in clause.excerpt before matching against originalText, or match against redactedText.

mechanism: RedactionDiff is rendered without semanticPii={report.semanticPii}, so the Stage 0.5 Semantic PII summary strip is never displayed.
recommendation: Pass semanticPii={report.semanticPii} to <RedactionDiff />.

mechanism: customTermDraft only commits on Enter or comma, with no onBlur commit and no rendered chip list, so users cannot see or remove committed custom terms.
recommendation: Render customTermChips with remove buttons and commit draft terms on blur.

mechanism: System & AI Diagnostics modal and Proof of Privacy modal (lines 1834-1871) lack Escape key handlers.
recommendation: Add Escape keydown listeners to close diagnosticsOpen and privacyDrawerOpen modals.

mechanism: Export dropdown menu has no outside-click or Escape key handler to close when open.
recommendation: Add outside-click and Escape listeners for exportMenuOpen.
